title: Eviction preference boundary: overflow evicts the first NON-SENSITIVE observation before any sensitive one — labeled-but-benign entries buffer the ledger
note: Second eviction rule: once the cap is full of sensitive entries, each internal_docs (declared label 'internal' — non-sensitive) mint evicts the previous non-sensitive entry, NOT the oldest secret. So secret-value-0 (evicted before the internals arrived) lost identity tracking, while secret-value-1 and secret-value-511 both keep it. All checks stay deny via the label rule. Declared non-secret labels are operator facts, not a DLP judgment.
